entries.title: Age of Wonders
entries.definitive_edition: Age of Wonders on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 1999 strategy game.

primary.why: The original Age of Wonders is a Windows PC release, making Windows PC both the only sourced route and the best capture/compatibility path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC digital release through Steam or GOG, using compatibility fixes if needed.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows PC release, now available through current PC storefronts.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced public release route is Windows PC only.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later Age of Wonders games are sequels or spin-offs, not remasters of the 1999 original.

entries.title: Age of Wonders III
entries.definitive_edition: Age of Wonders III on Windows PC with Golden Realms and Eternal Lords

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with Golden Realms and Eternal Lords
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the strongest route for Age of Wonders III because it has the full expansion path, mod support, and the best capture/settings flexibility. macOS and Linux are valid native routes but are not better than Windows PC for streaming and support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam or GOG and add Golden Realms plus Eternal Lords for the full official expansion path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with expansion and mod route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete and capture route.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC-family releases share the same content family; Windows PC is the best practical route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Golden Realms and Eternal Lords are expansions, not separate game entries.

entries.title: Age of Wonders: Planetfall
entries.definitive_edition: Age of Wonders: Planetfall on Windows PC with Season Pass expansions

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with Season Pass content
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best Planetfall route, with the full expansion path, mouse/keyboard controls, mod support, and the cleanest capture/settings setup. PS4, Xbox One, and macOS are valid routes, but they add no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, GOG, or Paradox and add Revelations, Invasions, and Star Kings for the full expansion path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with expansion and mod route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete and capture route.
skip: valid console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and less mod/control flexibility.
skip: valid console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and less mod/control flexibility.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC remains both the complete expansion route and the best capture/control route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Revelations, Invasions, and Star Kings are expansions, not separate game entries. Planetfall is a sci-fi spin-off in the Age of Wonders series.

entries.title: Age of Wonders 4
entries.definitive_edition: Age of Wonders 4 on Windows PC with current expansion-pass content

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native modern PC presentation with mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with expansion-pass content
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best route for Age of Wonders 4 because it has the current expansion-pass/DLC path, mouse-and-keyboard controls, mod support, and the best capture/settings flexibility. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are strong same-day console routes, but they add no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Microsoft Store/Game Pass for PC, or Paradox and add the expansion-pass DLC you want for the full current content path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with DLC/expansion-pass and mod route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete, control, and capture route.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and less mod/control flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S release with cloud/Game Pass access paths.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console/subscription route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and less mod/control flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: All launch platforms are valid, but PC is the complete/mod/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Age of Wonders 4's expansion-pass packs are DLC, not separate game entries.
